description: Observed-order-of-accuracy sweep for grids/cartesian_uniform_1d/rules/weno5_D_periodic driven by problems/advection_1d_periodic_weno5.esm, loaded once per resolution with the loader-API metaparameter binding (esm-spec 9.7.6 binding site 4). Exact solution sin(2 pi (x - c t)); the dominant discretization error is the fifth-order WENO5-Z conservative flux-difference truncation -(dx^5/60) u^(6) (derivation in the problem file), expected to fall as O(dx^5). Julia integrator tolerances are pinned tight (reltol 1e-12, abstol 1e-14) so the Tsit5 temporal truncation stays well below the finest spatial error (~2e-9 at N=128), isolating the spatial order.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator

blocked_upstream_bindings.python: Python's LSODA actuals sit outside this manifest's error_vs_golden tolerances against the Julia (Tsit5) reference goldens at the finest resolution only: n=128 L2 2.9957521244068676e-09 vs golden 2.9834111797852627e-09 and Linf 2.995442116571212e-09 vs 2.983110314325188e-09 (rel ~4.1e-3 vs rtol 1e-4); n=16/32/64 pass. The n=128 error is at the ~3e-9 discretization/solver floor, where the two integrators' truncation profiles differ deterministically. The python value is bitwise-stable across numpy 2.0.2/py3.9 (local) and numpy 2.5.2/py3.12 (CI run 33266361681), and PROVEN independent of EarthSciAST caea886aa's broadcast-contraction path (ESS_NP_CONTRACT_DISABLE=1 A/B is bit-identical) - the same deterministic method-disagreement class as the two rust Erk floors (latlon3d_advection_vertical_zero_grad / _zonal_ppm_flux), surfaced only now because CI run 33266361681 is the FIRST python job ever to reach the convergence golden comparison. MEASURED 2026-08-29. Re-arm by re-baselining this case's golden or gating per-resolution.
